thread.title: Nasdaq falls 1% as technology stocks weigh

author: morningstar.com
title: Nasdaq falls 1% as technology stocks weigh
text:
U.S. stocks fell on Thursday, with the Nasdaq dropping to its low of the session as large-capitalization technology stocks weighed on the index. The Nasdaq fell 1%. While the day's losses were broad, selling was particularly heavy in the tech sector, which was down 1.5%. Apple Inc. (AAPL), the largest stock in both the sector and the overall market, shed 2.5%. The tech giant was pressured after Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co. Ltd. (2330.TW)gave an outlook that was below expectations (http://www.marketwatch.com/story/apple-chipmaker-stocks-fall-after-tsmc-delivers-weaker-than-expected-outlook-2018-04-19), raising questions about demand for the overall industry. Chipmaker stocks were also pressured, with Nvidia Corp. (NVDA) shares down 3.4% and Qualcomm Inc. (QCOM) shedding 4.3%. Applied Materials Inc. (AMAT) was down 5.9%. The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 0.6% while the S&P 500 was off 0.8%.
-Ryan Vlastelica; 1213ET
